lessons: A single headline from one man can erase a bullish setup - position for binary headline risk, not for the base case.

summary: Surprise ~300-point rally on constant buying despite an Iran-missile headline; FIIs ₹3,000 crore buyers, DIIs ₹1,000 crore - real money, not just covering. Crude whipsawed $82.5→$90 (+10% in 24h); Fed decision due 11:30 pm; 24,382 technical-long trigger approaching.

summary: Dow fell 1,000+ points (rare) after the Fed held and US 30-year yield hit 5.2% - market reads the Fed as behind the curve. Cognizant +11% brightens Indian IT; Meta -8%, Microsoft +8%. Korea rebounded on Samsung results. Iran missiles and $90 crude keep nerves high; August range 24,000-24,800 proposed.

events.claim: The Dow fell more than 1,000 points after the Fed kept rates unchanged - the market judged the Fed 'acting slowly' and pushed the 30-year US Treasury yield to ~5.2%, the highest level
Cognizant rose ~11%, Microsoft ~8%, Meta fell ~8% on results; Cognizant's guidance lifts Indian IT sentiment (Infosys, TCS)

summary: Nifty decisively crossed 24,300 (third straight close above) on IT strength and afternoon bank recovery; next targets 24,600/24,800. Pakistan-mediation and Hormuz-shipping headlines whipsawed expiry-day stops. August future premium collapsed ₹150→₹30 - abnormally cheap vs cost of carry.
